Subject: Your consumer complaint matter

Dear Mr. Pawar,

Thank you for meeting us on 5 July 2022 about your dispute with Fernandes Constructions. As we understand it, the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate. The matter is listed before the Jaipur District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

Our advice is to seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate. Please collect the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and the municipal reply on the occupancy certificate and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 9,10,00,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor

spans.text: Jaipur District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
